about: The Vivec Arena minigame's player fighter (dbgmode arenapit, docs/COMBAT.md): a set sheet so arena fights test the rules with a capable fighter instead of whatever character the game started with. tools/prepare_combat.py computes it from the owned master with the original autocalculation (race, class, level), applies the overrides and writes one row per loadout to arena/player.txt. In game: aw_arena_player 1 (default) uses it, 0 fights with your own character sheet; dbgmode arenapit loadout NAME picks a loadout. A shield needs a one-handed weapon (fists and two-handed weapons cannot block). Until the first-person weapon views land, weapon loadouts fight with the weapon's rules while the view shows the hands. The quick character screen will replace this file's role when it lands.
name: Arena Challenger
note: Skill overrides lift the Monk's weapon and block skills so weapon loadouts are fair tests; Hand-to-hand stays the class's own (a major skill).
